S55 and S82 independently reproduce an almost pure 0.19922 d sinusoid with ~80 ppt peak-to-trough. The reported deep windows are ordinary smooth wave minima.
S17 has steep SAP drifts and almost perfectly anticorrelated SAP_BKG for all marked windows. Several corrected residuals survive, but no repeat appears in well-covered other sectors.

The S15 broad multi-day SAP-only troughs disappear. A separate coherent ~0.207522 d corrected component gives two virtually equal continuous minima on a 0.41504 d fold. There is no unique orbital-period identification.
